header.description: Outcome record for the hybrid-search evaluation that stopped at its floor. 60 representatives mined from real work; each entry names its primary labeled document (labeled before any ranker ran) and whether lexical search (the build at 32e2097f) found a labeled document in each call shape. Entries that lexical missed in at least one shape also list every labeled document; entries it always found list only the primary. No raw mined text and no session identifiers are stored; ids are opaque.

fields.id: opaque q-hNNN id; the number is not a rank or a date
fields.source: `dispatch`, `user` or `gh`, the kind of record the need came from
fields.primary: the single most relevant labeled document as {path, kind}; kind brainstorm adds ci_reproducible:false because docs/brainstorms/ is untracked
fields.targets: present only on an entry that lexical missed in at least one call shape (pastwork, solutions, all or sentence_form_pastwork): every labeled document as {path, kind}, with ci_reproducible:false on a brainstorm. An entry lexical always found has no targets field; its primary is the only listed path.
fields.lexical: `pastwork`: four per-kind calls at limit 5, found when any labeled path is in the top 5 of any call. `solutions`: one solution call at limit 8, scored on solution targets only (`applicable` is false when no solution is labeled). `all`: one `all` call at limit 5. `sentence_form_pastwork` runs the same four calls on the unconverted need sentence. Every shape records a boolean `found`; a miss also names a `miss_stratum` (`6-20`: ranked 6 to 20; `over-20`: shares a term but ranks beyond 20; `no-overlap`) and a find has none.
fields.totals: every count is derived from the entries: `by_target_kind` counts primaries; `solutions_shape` counts entries with a solution label (`applicable`), their misses, and the solution-primary subset; `miss_strata` counts misses per stratum for each of pastwork, solutions, all and sentence_form_pastwork
fields.primary_has_symptoms: whether the primary target carries `symptoms` frontmatter
fields.any_target_has_symptoms: whether any labeled target carries `symptoms` frontmatter

candidates.reason: The run stopped at the floor: fewer than 8 lexical misses in 60 representatives. No candidate ran on this set, so there are no per-candidate outcomes.
